cohort_total_n_excerpt: During 1999-2004, a population-based case-control study with 512 cases and 838 controls was conducted.
reason: The study evaluates early-onset prostate cancer, defined by diagnosis at age 60 years or younger. Early onset is an age-defined general prostate cancer endpoint and is not itself an aggressive, high-grade, advanced, metastatic, or lethal endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Cases were diagnosed with prostate cancer when < or = 60 years.
estimate_classifications.reason: The PUFA estimate is for age-defined early-onset prostate cancer generally; the abstract does not establish aggressive disease.
